title: Grouped list modal
description: A dialog that lists items in collapsible groups, with a search box on top. It is the Facilities List on the Dispatch screen: facilities grouped by district, each with its alert status pill. Groups start collapsed, opening one closes the others (the screen decides), and a group shows its rows 5 at a time with a Pagination footer (the older Show more button still works when paginated is not set). A row can show an alert status pill. Built from Modal shell, Text field, Section header and Link button. The screen owns the data, the search and which group is open; the dialog only draws them.

props.x: Modal title and the grey line under it.
Phosphor names for the title circle and for each group header.
Fixed size; the body scrolls once.
Search text and its input handler. The screen filters the data.
Bold line above the groups, for example "Search Results [14] Facilities".

Each group: title, sub, open, onToggle, items [{ name, detail, status?, statusVariant? }], shown, total, hasMore, moreLabel, onMore. A row with status shows an alert-status Pill (size s) before the detail; statusVariant is tint for no alerts, warning for secure mode, error for a lockdown (warning and error carry a dot). Add paginated: true with total, per (5), page, perOptions ([5, 10, 25]), onPage and onPer to page the rows with the Pagination component instead of the Show more button; items is then just the current page.
Plain line at the bottom, for example "Showing 14 facilities in 2 districts".

values.v: Modal shell, width 560, height 720, hideFooter, X in the header
padding 12px 16px, top divider 1px #eef0f3, name 14px / 600, detail 13px #6b7280, hover #f4f6f9
padding 12px 16px, fill #fafbfc, "Showing N of M" 13px, Link button (caret-down icon) for Show more
all groups collapsed; while searching the screen opens every matching group
Pill size s before the detail text with a 12px gap; tint No alerts, warning Secure mode active, error Lockdown active
Pagination component in the group footer on #fafbfc with a 1px #eef0f3 top border; 5 rows per page, per-page options 5, 10, 25
